bootsoff_R: A person sitting on the edge of a bed with both feet flat on the floor leans forward, grabs the heel of the right boot with both hands, pulls the boot off the right foot, then bends down and places the boot on the floor to the right outside of the right foot, and sits back up.
bucket_dump: A standing person holds a heavy bucket in front of the waist with the right hand on the rim and the left hand under the bottom, tips it forward and down to pour the water out over a railing, then lowers the empty bucket.
kneel_fill: A person walks up, kneels down on the left knee, reaches forward and down with the right hand to dip a bucket into water about half a meter in front of the knees, holds it there, then stands back up.
rail_lean: A person stands leaning forward with both forearms resting on a railing at chest height, weight on one leg, and slowly looks left and right at the view, relaxed.
floor_pickup: A person bends at the waist with slightly bent knees, picks up a log from the floor in front of the feet with both hands, and stands up holding it at the waist.
